title: Generate input structures
action: Construct unit cells for the six VN phases (NaCl, WC, AsNi, t-VN, ZnS, CsCl) using lattice parameters from the paper. Build 64-atom supercells for NaCl-based and WC-based V_xN_x with vacancy concentrations x = 1.0, 0.96875, 0.9375, 0.90625, 0.875, and impurity supercells V32N29C3 and V32N29O3, by adding/removing atoms appropriately.
description: Create all required atomic configurations for DFT calculations.

title: DFT geometry optimization and total energy
action: For each structure (six unit cells and all supercells), perform DFT relaxation using QUANTUM ESPRESSO with Vanderbilt ultrasoft pseudopotentials, PBE GGA, plane-wave cutoff 38 Ry, and appropriate k-point meshes. Relax cell parameters and atomic positions until forces < 1 mRy/bohr and stresses < 0.025 GPa. Record equilibrium total energies and structures.
description: Obtain relaxed structures and total energies for subsequent analysis.

title: Total energies of stoichiometric VN phases
action: Extract total energy per atom (in meV/atom) for the six stoichiometric phases (WC, AsNi, t-VN, NaCl, ZnS, CsCl) from the relaxation results and write to step_01_total_energies.csv.
description: Total energy per atom for each stoichiometric VN phase.

title: DFPT phonon calculations
action: For the WC, AsNi, t-VN, and NaCl relaxed structures, compute phonon dispersion and density of states using DFPT with a 6x6x6 q-mesh and interpolate to obtain PHDOS. Identify imaginary (negative) frequency modes.
description: Determine dynamical stability of the four lowest-energy phases.

title: Phonon dynamical stability flags
action: Write a CSV file indicating for each of the four phases whether imaginary phonon modes are present (true) or not (false).
description: Dynamic stability flags for NaCl, t-VN, AsNi, WC.

title: Electronic density of states calculations
action: For all NaCl-based and WC-based supercells (stoichiometric, vacancy-containing, impurity-containing), compute total DOS using fine k-point meshes and extract N(E_F), the density of states at the Fermi level.
description: Obtain N(E_F) values for all compositions.

title: Fermi-level DOS values
action: Write step_03_NofEF.csv with N(E_F) for each configuration.
description: Density of states at the Fermi level for each composition.
output_schema: columns: structure_type (string, 'NaCl-based' or 'WC-based'), configuration (string, e.g., V32N32, V31N31, V30N30, V29N29, V28N28, V32N29C3, V32N29O3), N_E_F (float, units states/eV per unit cell)
